task_description: Suppose you have a directory called /data that contains sensitive files that should only be accessible to members of the group "dataaccess". # Step 3: Change group ownership of /data to "dataaccess"

# Step 4: Set setgid bit (2) so new files/dirs inherit the group, and sticky bit (1) so only owners can delete
